headline: GloRilla responds to a fan account on X telling her to keep her upcoming Sexyy Red collab,
body: GloRilla responds to a fan account on X telling her to keep her upcoming Sexyy Red collab, “Jiggly Bow Bow,” after she shared a teaser of the song, which drops Nov. 6. “I’m kindly saying f**k y’all I do what I want. If you don’t like it, don’t listen. I luv you 🏼 God bless. ”.
